links.status: DRAFT: not frozen, not launch authorization; unresolved identity and execution prerequisites listed in extensions.

question: On the fixed 1,260 public synthetic mathematical workloads, what are the independently verified completion outcomes and qualified full-method-call and online clock ratios of the signed symbolic pencil collector against matched rho?

claims.text: Every accepted synthetic result satisfies the original source-curve equation and archived known answer; failures, caps and missing outcomes remain visible.
Report per-workload candidate/rho common full-method-call clock ratios only after paired identity, L2, independent verification and the independently applied cold A/A admission pass.
claims.if_supported: Descriptive ratios on admitted public fixtures, with denominators and missing outcomes.
claims.if_not_supported: Invalid or incomplete clock observations retained with null qualified ratios.

claims.text: Report online ratios only after the separate online admission passes; neither online nor cold result is a complete counted-cost price or general speed claim.
Deployed-key recovery, cryptographic security impact, asymptotic advantage, universal mathematical correctness and full GAE cost ratios are outside this clock experiment.

arms.description: Signed symbolic point-driven pencil collector, cold per-call construction/transfer charged. Actual prepared arm label is pencil.
Matched source negation rho; also the unmodified reference baseline. Per-workload archived cap resolved by the prepared spec.
Identical resolved rho method and algorithm seed, separate scheduled execution.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Every fixed public fixture contains a known synthetic answer checked in child and independently by parent/source audit; a wrong answer invalidates the execution. These checks exercise the same method path; no fourth arm is introduced.

negative.not_applicable_reason: No detection or enrichment/null-population claim. Deterministic rejection fixtures for altered identity, wrong equation, cap, missing phases and missing partners validate the analysis separately before freeze; they are not timed cohort samples.

factors.name: workload
factors.how: 21 models x60 exact archived targets; all arms share workload SHA and original source equation.

factors.name: instrument
factors.how: One immutable source commit, lockfile, flags, binary and image for all arms; unresolved hashes block freezing.

factors.name: threads
factors.how: Single method thread; pin physical-core placement and SMT sibling exclusion before execution.

factors.name: host
factors.how: Record instance ID/type, CPU model/microcode, SMT, affinity, NUMA, kernel, hypervisor, governor/frequency, steal, PSI, co-tenants and isolation blockers. Reject timed rows below L2; no cross-host timing pooling after recovery.

factors.name: placement
factors.how: Dedicated qualified L2 c8a.2xlarge Spot placement; no heterogeneous fallback.

factors.name: memory_environment
factors.how: 8GiB execution cap, same allocator preparation/environment for every arm; record actual RSS, allocator, ASLR and resolved environment. No memory-cap increase.

factors.name: arm_order
factors.how: Use existing prepared spec shuffle rule and seed2026101801; freeze emitted plan bytes before data. Interleave all three arms in each workload/round.

factors.name: algorithm_stream
factors.how: Five predetermined measured streams per workload shared exactly across all three arms; index0 preserves archived seed; indices1..4 are new streams, not repeat measurements of index0.

factors.name: warmup
factors.how: One warmup execution per arm/workload; retain records but exclude from ratios.

factors.name: preemption
factors.how: Retain checkpoint, interruption and restore records; resumed execution clocks invalid. Restart only under frozen infrastructure retry limit, never restart a scientific cap.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: Unblinded deterministic native exporter; no hand-selected workloads, thresholds or best stream. External reviewer receives all rows and reasons.

transfer_obligations.requirement: Verify domain/model/transfer identity on frozen fixtures; verify accepted geometric relations and returned synthetic answer on original source curve. Charge candidate setup and transfer inside method call; do not infer universal transfer theorem from finite checks.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Prepared measurement.order=shuffle, with interleaved workload/round scheduling; plan bytes frozen before observations.

seed_derivation.note: Prepared spec measurement.seed=2026101801 and algorithm_seed_round=measured_index. Native ecbench plan resolves per-workload archived seed at measured index0 and predetermined streams1..4. Exact decimal algorithm_seed, absolute round and sequence retained; all three arms must match within pair.

instance_sampling.rule: Use all 1260 exact archive workloads, 60/model, seven order sizes16,20,24,28,32,36,40; no resampling or substitution.

blinding.how: Known deterministic fixtures and method structures already observed; report unblinded descriptive measurements, not out-of-sample discovery or significance.

power.note: Fixed complete cohort for descriptive reproducibility, not a powered hypothesis test. Five streams characterize observed range only. The [0.90,1.10] rule is operational admission, not a confidence interval; alpha is schema-required and unused. No significance or power claim.

primary.name: Full method call
primary.definition: Immediately before methods::solve invocation to immediate return before profiling dump. Includes dispatch, parameter checks, per-call algorithm/model/transfer setup, target work, in-child verification and report construction. Excludes harness workload reconstruction, harness allocator preparation, child JSON serialization and parent audit. This is full method-call cost, not full process cost.
primary.resolution: integer nanoseconds; effective accuracy assessed by L2 and A/A

secondary.name: Online window
secondary.definition: Target-dependent window only; require checked integer sum of exactly the five declared phase clocks equal to online.wall_ns and explicit online_clock_diagnostics.error=null. Setup excluded; never substitute for cold.
secondary.resolution: integer nanoseconds; effective accuracy assessed by L2 and A/A

secondary.name: Five online phases
secondary.definition: Retain target_query,target_PDP,target_relation_check,target_descent,target_recovery_check separately; zero stages require explicit reasons. Phases partition online clock and are not added to total again.
secondary.resolution: integer nanoseconds; effective accuracy assessed by L2 and A/A

secondary.name: Parent mathematical audit
secondary.definition: Parent source multiplication and equality comparison only; no inherited child isolation, diagnostic only and never added to child clocks.
secondary.resolution: integer nanoseconds; effective accuracy assessed by L2 and A/A

secondary.name: Child process envelope
secondary.definition: Spawn to reap; overlaps method call and includes preparation; diagnostic, never summed with method-call time.
secondary.resolution: integer nanoseconds; effective accuracy assessed by L2 and A/A

secondary.name: Child maximum resident set
secondary.definition: Per-child process high-water RSS including preparation; not allocated bytes or additive across phases.

counters: raw field/scalar/symbolic counters with coverage flags
measurement.timed_primary_justification: Current native counts omit parts of setup/primality/logical work and allocator valuation; pricing them as total cost would be misleading. One common enclosing method-call clock captures implementation work symmetrically. L2 qualification plus independent cold/online five-stream A/A admission is mandatory; no claim about complete counted cost.

placement.isolation: dedicated L2; pin physical core and exclude its SMT sibling
placement.admission_status: UNRESOLVED: bind exact approved queue/job identity, image, recoverability and budget before freeze; do not infer research namespace permission
placement.recovery_contract: isolab.eks.resumable/v1; CRIU+encrypted EBS coherent snapshot; max_restores1; computation epoch always L0/timing-invalid; separate fresh benchmark epoch must independently pass L2/replay/A-A/downloaded S3 manifest.
placement.checkpoint_grace_note: 120 seconds is the draft maximum interruption grace budget, not a verified controller setting; confirm compatibility before freeze. Periodic300s checkpoints do not depend on receiving interruption notice.
placement.epoch: Fresh benchmark epoch only; computation CRIU+EBS epoch configured separately in extensions.computation_epoch. Checkpoint overhead and downtime retained outside benchmark clock, never added as faster method evidence.

stopping_rules.rule: First gate: all60 p739 workloads with all three arms and5 measured+1warmup streams. Second gate only after first verifies: p186379 target0 under original caps, plus independent process replay. Do not extend if either gate is capped, invalid or incomplete; preserve all outcomes.

Only after both gates and independent review pass, fill all1260 workloads x3arms x(5measured+1warmup)=22680 planned base executions. Qualifying identical gate executions may count once toward the cohort; replay is separately identified and never double-counted.

Per execution25,000,000 stored coefficients,8GiB and3600 seconds. No cap increase, new seed, alternative partition or automatic scientific retry. Infrastructure retry at most2 attempts preserves original inputs and absolute budget; cumulative job/resource admission is unresolved and blocks freeze.
Wrong source answer or violated geometric identity stops affected method admission and requires reviewed correction/amendment; all prior records retained.

invalidation_rules: Any missing/duplicate/mismatched plan row, workload, seed, method, arm, round or artifact identity blocks affected pairing.
Unverified, exhausted, capped, wrong-answer or absent records retain status and null ratios, not substituted values.
Clock below L2, restored/interrupted execution, nonpositive timer, isolation blockers or unmatched instrumentation blocks timed admission.

Cold and online admission independent: exactly5 eligible A/A pairs each, identical resolved rho methods, every rho_AA/rho within inclusive[0.90,1.10] by integer cross-products. A missing round or one failure invalidates that metric for the workload.
Online additionally requires exact phase sum and explicit error:null; absence is unknown.
Do not pool only successful workloads as if complete1260 cohort. Report every exclusion and fixed denominator.

decision_rule.text: No significance or superiority verdict. After independent protocol/source/binary/record review, classify each metric/workload as qualified_observation only if all5 matched candidate/reference rows verify and its separate A/A admission passes. Otherwise retain raw observations and null qualified ratio. Report per-stream ratios and median/min/max descriptively. Do not infer one metric admission from the other.
decision_rule.threshold: All five rho_AA/rho ratios separately in[0.90,1.10] for cold and online; exact integer check90*rho<=100*rho_AA<=110*rho.
decision_rule.statistic: Candidate/rho per exact workload/stream; observed median,min,max of five eligible ratios. No cohort ranking or survivor-only total.
decision_rule.interval: Observed five-stream range only; tolerance is operational, not CI.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Dimensionless per-stream paired clock ratio; clocks and outcome denominators also retained.

inadmissible: Launching from this draft or treating schema validity as freeze/approval.
Replacing unresolved identity with a guessed commit/image or reusing historical timing as current data.
Changing frozen cohort, cap, small_denominator8, seeds, order, threshold or analysis after observations without dated amendment.
Presenting incomplete counts as full cost ratios; suppressing losses, failed AA, caps or missing workload outcomes.
Treating five new algorithm streams as identical-seed timing repeats, or [0.90,1.10] as a CI.
Re-running capped scientific outcomes under infrastructure retry authority.
Claiming CRIU recovery or L2 from successful pod status alone.

extensions.full_counted_cost_status: unresolved; clock experiment does not discharge original full cost accounting requirement
extensions.gate_replay: Independent replay checks exact non-wall outcomes and counts; does not require identical clocks and does not increase target count
extensions.baseline_scope: rho serves reference and unmodified baseline; historical online/peel/Markowitz data are context only, not fresh matched baseline arms.
extensions.recovery_epoch_accounting: 22680 planned base measurement executions plus the controller computation epoch and independent replay, all separately represented in resource admission and flow. Computation cannot qualify clock ratios even without restore; no duplicate benchmark counted as new targets.
extensions.gate_preflight: The first capped gate itself supplies fixed/per-execution runtime observations; no additional uncapped measurement is authorized by absent preflight estimates.

computation_epoch.purpose: Durable computation and independent replay; never contributes to primary or secondary timed comparison, even without restore. Native controller starts distinct fresh benchmark epoch described by execution.

extensions.whole_run_resource_accounting: Retain every computation, warmup, gate, benchmark, control, replay, checkpoint, restore and infrastructure attempt and its resource/time cost in export flow. Separate algorithm method-call metric from whole study cost; no erasure of computation/control or first-gate costs. Never sum overlapping child/process/phase clocks.
